source: Naoto Date, Manga Artist’s Guide to Digital Color & Lighting, printed pages 26–27; user-supplied extracts
method: Manual calibration of square bounds, vertical gray band and vivid notch; lower curve traced from longest chromatic column, median-smoothed across 5 pixels, then sampled at 3-pixel steps. Closed contour resampled to 96 points for correspondence. Measurement uncertainty ±5 source pixels (~3.3% of the source square), including scan and curve tracing. Inter-hue interpolation is an app extension.
